scope: CRD v3 exact two-operation conditional XBRL connector retention only
changes_requested_and_verified: Reject XML byte mismatch and DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations in a separate IF before either XML parsing call.
Use IS DISTINCT FROM for null-safe UNKNOWN manifest validation.
Add a same-byte-length DTD/entity rejection fixture so the declaration guard is exercised independently of byte-length mismatch.

reviewed_invariants.exact_two_call_sequence: Route 11 exact filename-filtered metadata only; route 12 exact observed XML URL only after retained SUCCESS and verified 1..1800000-byte size evidence. Fixed manifest and reservation events prevent reissue.
reviewed_invariants.prior_failure_preservation: Original exact metadata and 157-byte CRD HTML error source hashes plus UNKNOWN and ERROR_RECONCILED events are required. The scripts never update/delete those objects. Prior provider outcome remains unknown.
reviewed_invariants.resource_accounting: Each committed reservation increments logical provider/HTTP-operation counters once and reserves its full retained-representation cap. Successful retain releases only its reservation and adds actual serialized UTF8 bytes. Exact replay returns before counter changes. Unknown preserves counters, reservation bytes and manual hold.
reviewed_invariants.csv_parser: Bounded16KiB matching complete text copies, unique headers and exactly one accession/filename/size row; quoted commas, doubled quotes, CRLF and quoted newlines are handled. Invalid metadata is retained with body admission false.
reviewed_invariants.xml_extraction: Allowed exact JSON string paths only; selected string must match reported UTF8 file size; DTD/entity declarations rejected before parser; well-formed document and xbrl local root required; duplicate strings must match when both exist. No third body copy stored.
reviewed_invariants.source_identity_and_replay: Complete retained JSON raw UTF8 content/hash/length, URI, provider, retrieval time, license and full evidence compared on replay/conflict. Publication and historical receipt times remain NULL.
reviewed_invariants.unknown_effect: No automatic retry, pagination or hold release. Late complete response can be retained under the existing reservation. New uncertain operations do not qualify for the prior HTML-only reconciliation exception.
reviewed_invariants.controller_scope: Current root owner/fence/stop/scope, unexpired admission/deadline, paused cron and drained task/provider leases required. No new workers, permanent functions, adapter bindings, fake attempts, company overrides or publication.

limitations_and_execution_gates: Root actual rollback fixture execution remains required; this review does not claim PostgreSQL runtime PASS.
The admission counts logical connector operations; internal transport retries and physical HTTP request count are not observed.
Retained JSON caps and reported source size do not guarantee connector transport fits; oversize/truncated/unknown responses remain held without reissue.
Retained connector serialization and extracted XML string are not original HTTP wire-byte proof.
XBRL structural extraction does not verify accession entity identity, dated share classes, publication timing, market capitalization, final company membership, or invoice totals.
